publishedfiledetails.title: Crock Pot Rebalance
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Rebalances Crock Pot food values to make recipes more consistent and fair.

Main goals:
- Strong recipes are toned down if they are disproportionately powerful
- Weak recipes are improved to make them more worthwhile
- Food stats better reflect the character of the dish:
  - more meat-focused dishes give more Hunger
  - more vegetable-focused dishes give more Health
  - sweeter or more luxurious dishes give more Sanity

This mod changes the final stats of prepared food prefabs.
Compatible with recipe-preview mods such as Smart Crock Pot.

publishedfiledetails.title: Smarter Crock Pot
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
WARNING: Mod has not been updated a long time. Read the comment section.

Do you find yourself confused over the many recipes the crock pot offers?
Do you need to check online before cooking?

This mod alters to Crock Pot to show you what you're going to cook,
without cooking it, saving you the time and from unfortunate mistakes.
See upfront even the expected spoilage.
in the game, when multiple recipes with the same priority are available, the cooking product is chosen at random- now you can see every option before gambling.

Compatible with DisplayFoodValues,DetailedToolTips,AdvancedToolTips
So you can see the values of your cooking.
Even add the chances of cooking your product into the tooltip.
Compatible with Waiter101 and any other food mods, shows all mod recipes.

Works For EVERY ONE, the mod is Client only.

False Prediction may arise from difference 
between the Client's cookbook and the Server's cookbook.

USING A CONTROLLER?
For a long time it wasn't supported, but now it is!
Just go to the mod config and ACTIVATE IT.
To predict using Controller, all you have to do is to put 4 items in the cookpot and then nav to the fifth empy item. Nav to it again (I recommend Nav-ing Right) to predict again for the other possible products.

Test with the mod only to see bug came from a different mod.

Found a Bug? Want a feature?
You can conribute here:
https://github.com/SmarterCrockPot/SmarterCrockPot

publishedfiledetails.title: Balanced Crock Pot Dishes
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1] Makes Crock Pot dishes more balanced and meaningful.  [/h1] 

 This mod was inspired by the Recipe Rebalancer mod by Terostrous. 

 Many recipes had their food stats changed. Full list can be found in: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1E6iK4T1DcgMUvIwdRSS10lfoXti089zn6t19KLnTY5U/edit?usp=sharing

[b]NOT YET UPDATED FOR WARLY'S RECIPES[/b]

[h2]Major changes[/h2]
-Most raw foods now recover less hunger and health
-Many Crock Pot foods also recover less health and hunger
-Many Crock Pot foods now recover a bit more sanity
-Recipes of Bunny Stew, Kabobs and Meatballs were tweaked
-Through the configuration menu, you can reduce the meat value of Monster Meat for added challenge(recommended)

[h2]Notable food-specific changes:[/h2]
[h3]Bunny Stew[/h3]
-Recipe now has no limit on meat, but has lower priority than meatballs
-Recovers only 31.25 hunger and 8 health(reduced from 37.5 and 20 respectively)

[h3]Kabobs[/h3]
-Recipe now requires at least 1 meat, but recovers 43.75 hunger(increased from 37.5)
-Takes less time to cook(reduced from 40 seconds to 20)

[h3]Meatballs[/h3]
-Recipe now requires at least 1.5 meat, and recovers 56.25 hunger(reduced from 62.5)
-Takes 20 seconds to cook instead of 15

[h3]Meaty Stew[/h3]
-Now recovers only 100 hunger instead of 150

[h3]Fishsticks[/h3]
-Instead of a healing food, it is now a snack that provides cheap sanity
-Recovers 15 sanity but only 8 health(8 is the minimum health for fish-based recipes) and 12.5 hunger
-Takes less time to cook(reduced from 40 seconds to 10)

[h3]Fist Full of Jam[/h3]
-Now recovers only 18.75 hunger(reduced from 37.5) but provides 10 sanity

[h3]Mushy Cake[/h3]
-Now recovers 25 hunger, 15 sanity and 20 health(the culmination of all caps)

[h3]Stuffed Eggplant[/h3]
-Now recovers 30 health

[h3]Froggle Bunwich[/h3]
-Now recovers 12 health instead of 20
-Takes less time to cook(reduced from 40 seconds to 20)

[h3]Trail Mix[/h3]
-Nerfed in terms of health, recovering only 8; but provides 10 sanity as well as 18.75 hunger
-Now lasts a whopping 40 days, acting like a dried fruit
-Takes 40 seconds to cook(drying ain't easy)

[h3]Taffy[/h3]
-Restores a bit more sanity(20 instead of 15) but less hunger(12.5 instead of 25)
-Now also lasts 40 days, which makes it better for emergencies and spelunking activities

[h3]General Principles[/h3]
-Foods now recover hunger, sanity and health in a manner that is more correlated with the values of their ingredients, as well as the difficulty of acquiring their ingredients; cheap recipes are no longer better than expensive ones(hopefully)
-Some ingredient types also have general characteristics, as outlined below
-Recipes that recover 40 health are now in the minority. This is restricted for recipes that are made with relatively less common ingredients
-But there are still a lot of recipes that recover 20 health and some even recover 30 health
-Some raw fruits now provide a small amount of sanity, but don't provide as much health

[h3]General Ingredient Characteristics[/h3]
-Meat foods usually recover hunger well.
-Sweet, savory or fruity foods recover sanity well.
-Veggie foods recover health well.
-Foods made with honey that are not candy also recover some health(but not too much)
-Fish foods can provide good hunger as well as some health depending on the recipe(minimum 8 health)
-Barnacle is still a very filling ingredient

publishedfiledetails.title: Fast Clientside Crockpot Cooking
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Copyright 2020-2023 "CarlZalph".  This item is not authorized for posting on Steam, except under the Steam account named CarlZalph.

Makes cooking in crockpots easier when mass-producing many of the same thing with the same ingredients by repeating it.
Also supports Warly's Spicer.

Stores the last recipe cooked manually with the 'Cook' button in a full crockpot for later.
Attempting to cook in an empty crockpot will try to look for all of the ingredients available to cook the same recipe with the same ingredients again.

While holding CTRL and opening a crockpot with a recipe already stored, it will try to do the same function again but without having to hit the 'Cook' button.

Ingredients have a priority from where they'll be tried to be cooked from:
1] Player inventory.
2] Player backpack.
3] Any other container, randomly.

Please keep this in mind if you have spoiled ingredients in your inventory and are trying to cook with fresh ones from a fridge, it will try to use the ones in the inventory first.



This mod functions both when as a pure client and when local hosting a non-caves server.

Controller support not here, please use the mod found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1706782853]HERE[/url] for a potential workaround.  It adds functionality.




Changelog:
0.1.3.2- Fix the crash from control-clicking due to Klei's changes to the container component and actions.
0.1.3.1- Support for the current Beta branch's method for container params.
0.1.3- Mod compatibility fix by recursively looking through functions to find the params table from containers.lua.
0.1.2.1- Wrong modinfo fix.
0.1.2- Checks for 'params' to exist and fix the upvalue scanning to not infinite loop if it can't find it.
0.1.1- Generalized the hooking process and added support for Warly's spicer.
0.1.0- Release.

publishedfiledetails.title: Terra's Handicaper and Crockpot Patcher.
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
NOTE: Please do not copy code from this mod without asking me first, I'm usually fine or indifferent with most my mods, but for this one I would like to be notified or asked first. Thank you for understanding.

A mod that serves two purposes. First of all it can be used to give challenge in worlds even with many food mods enabled, secondly it aims to fix older(and abandoned) crockpot food mods not being supported by Warly's portable crockpot.(Spice is beyond my current modding experience.)

Challenge Modifiers.
-----
The following can be modified via config settings.
-----
Picky Eater - You now only eat foods from crockpots(just like Warly!), works with all crockpot dishes as long as the mod has given the crockpot dish the "preparedfood" tag! (Enabled by default)

Eater Mode - Restrict yourself to specific food groups! Configurable! Carnivore restricts you to a meat diet(like Wigfrid!) while Vegetarian restricts you to a No Meat diet(like Wurt!). Set to Default to disable. (Defaults to Default)

Food Memory - Modifies Warly's food memory timer, you can reduce it, or increase it! By default it is set to the vanilla value of 2 days. Options include half a day, 1 day, 2 days, 4 days, 6 days, 8 days, 10 days, 20 days and 40 days.
Food Memory also applies to anyone using the Bland Flavors mod! Find it here.
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1819424070

Mercy Kit - A starter kit consisting of a Crockpot blueprint and the materials to build one. For a little less RNG dependance early on when playing Picky Eater mode. (Enabled by Default)

Curse of Pacifism - Makes you take karma damage when attacking mobs or murdering animals!
Karma damage taken for attacking is equal to 20% of your maximum health.
Karma damage taken for murdering animals in the inventory is equal to 40% of your maximum health as well as 33% of your maximum sanity and 25% of your maximum hunger.
Karma instantly kills you for cooking live animals.

No Food Healing - Self explanitory, any food item with a positive health value has that value set to 0, so basically you can't heal with food if this is enabled. Negative health values are unaffected.

Metabolism - Set your hunger rate value! Defaults to 100%. Options include 25%, 33%, 50%, 66%, 75%, 88%, 100%, 120%, 125%, 133%, 150%, 166%, 175%, 200%, 225%, 250%, 275%, 300%, 400%, 500%, 600%, 700% and 800%!

Favorite Food Bonus - Allows one to enable or disable the 15 bonus hunger granted from favorite foods. This is enabled by default, disabling it will disable the 15 extra hunger points gained from food.

This mod also attempts to fix other modded crockpot dishes, current fixes are below, if you wish to play this mod only for these fixes, then you can disable all options, set metabolism to 100% and keep the food memory on the vanilla setting.
-----
Budding Chef Additions!
-----
Portacrocks for all - Allows all characters to use the portable crockpot, portable seasoning station and portable grinding mill. This setting also makes the mercy kit give a Portable Crockpot to start with, rather then its usual crockpot materials. Disabled by default.

Fast Cook - Allows for all characters to cook fast, just like Willow, Warly and Walter. Disabled by Default.
-----
Mod Tweaks
-----
Beefalo Milk and Cheese - Cheesecake, Berry Milkshake and cheeses are no longer considered meat, Pizza on the other hand is still such as it uses meat in its crockpot recipe. All recipes now also work with Warly's portable crockpot. I will add more tweaks in the future. If Feast and Famine is enabled, then this support is disabled to allow Feast and Famine's support to work instead.

Japari Buns - Portable Crockpot can now cook them.

Birds and Berries and Trees for Friends - Apple Pie and Pineapple Medley are now cookable in the Portable Crockpot, have a higher priority and the Pineapple Medley should now be tagged as "preparedfood", both dishes were also buffed because they were laughably useless in the base mod.

Windy Plains - All crockpot dishes can now be made in Warly's portable crockpot.

Custom Farming/Feast and Famine/Heap of Foods - Extends the Mealing Stone to be able to craft new recipes, all are configurable. These recipes include the following.
-Nightmare Fuel(Moved from Refine Tab)
-Spot Spice(Requires Sugarwood Forest! Moved from Refine Tab. This recipe isn't included for Heap of Foods due to that mod already having a spot spice recipe and item.)
-Bone Shards(Incompatible with my Craftable Bone Shards mod)
-Butter

Feast and Famine + Island Adventures - Tweaks Carrot Cake to now accept coconuts in place of birchnuts.

Advanced Farming - Hybrid Bananas should now work for the banana pops recipe.
-Has "Celestial Knowledge" support!

Fish Farm - Has "Celestial Knowledge" support!

Additional Equipment [Fixed] - Adds a Celestial Gift option for Lying Robots! Making the Ice Pack item renewable.

Cherry Forest - Adds an option to allow bloomy honey to be used in making honey ham, honey nuggets, powdercake and fresh fruit crepes.

Heap of Foods - Adds a tweak option for a few of its recipes, this is disabled by default.
---The HoF tweak does the following, it makes the Shooter Sandwich, Pot Roast, Meat Wellington and Steak Frites no longer accept a monster value of 2 or higher, this tweak also makes Poi and Lotus Chips no longer accept meat, ice or petals as filler. These recipes are otherwise the same as in the original mod. This change requires heap of foods and will do nothing without it enabled.
---This change also tweaks the Monster Lasagna recipe, it now only won't accept vanilla inedibles(twigs, bone shards, nightmare fuel and volt goat horns) as filler, rather then all inedibles, this is to prevent the nerfs above from resulting in wet goop(as flour and spot spice are considered "inedibles").
---HoF Tweaks also reduces several spoil times on superslow perish items. The list below are the spoil changes.
---HoF Tweaks also adds a long pig drop to krampi and klaus, this is 20% on krampi, but klaus always drops 4.

Meat Wellington spoils in 15 days(down from 40)
Pizza spoils in 15 days(down from 40)
Shepherds Pie spoils in 20 days(down from 40)
Curry spoils in 15 days(down from 40)
Sweet Potato Souffle spoils in 10 days(down from 40)
Cheesecake spoils in 10 days(down from 40)
Cream of Mushroom Soup spoils in 8 days.(down from 40)

I've also added an option to revert the Monster Tartare food item back to how it is in shipwrecked. If this option is enabled, Monster Tartare will now heal 3 health, 37.5 hunger and 10 sanity, but will require an egg and a vegetable in addition to a monster value of 2 or more and will take 40 seconds to cook. If Feast and Famine is detected, a Meat Value of 2 or more is also required to prevent 3 monstrous eggs + a veggie from being used to make it. This option is Disabled by default.

Another option adds the option to tweak a few vanilla crockpot recipes, namely some less used ones, this is to hope they'll be used more. Enable it for the following.

Fruit Medley now gives 37.5 hunger(up from 25) and 20 sanity(up from 5)
Fish Tacos now gives 75 hunger(up from 37.5) and lasts alot longer.
Guacamole now gives 112.5 hunger(up from 37.5)  but penalizes 3 health and 5 sanity.
Spicy Chili now gives 62.5 hunger(up from 37.5)
Unagi now gives 37.5 hunger(up from 18.75) Still useless but I wanted to tweak it anyway.
This option is disabled by default.

Have fun! Try not to starve!
